points.description: States that the process requires high-skill (skilled) labour / highly skilled operators.
States that the process is inefficient because of a low metal removal rate (MRR), using the term metal removal rate / MRR and linking it to low value.
points.partial_credit: Half only if says 'slow' or 'inefficient' without naming metal removal rate (MRR).

points.description: States that the process is generally expensive (high cost).

rubric.notes: Full marks need all three drawbacks: high-skill labour, low metal removal rate (MRR) causing inefficiency, and being expensive. Each point is all or nothing except P2, which gets part credit only for slow or inefficient without naming MRR. Wrong statements (e.g. high MRR, needs unskilled labour) or vague ones earn nothing for that point. Final total is rounded to the nearest whole mark (0, 1 or 2).Round totals: 2 for all three, 1 for two, 0 otherwise.
